unique.kettle-of-endless-soup.name: Kettle of Endless Soup
unique.kettle-of-endless-soup.blurb: It has never been empty and never been washed. The Watch will walk an extra hour for a bowl, and they are not subtle about saying so.
unique.snickering-dagger.name: The Snickering Dagger
unique.snickering-dagger.blurb: It finds the first blow of any fight hilarious. Opponents report the sound as the worst part, which is saying something.
unique.grandmas-battle-ladle.name: Grandma's Battle Ladle
unique.grandmas-battle-ladle.blurb: Seasoned in every sense. Blocks with it come back at the attacker with a CLANG and a strong implication that they should sit down and eat.
unique.polite-grimoire.name: The Polite Grimoire
unique.polite-grimoire.blurb: Casts harder than its peers and apologises to each target afterwards. Scholars disagree about whether this makes it worse.
unique.boots-of-somewhere-else.name: Boots of Somewhere Else
unique.boots-of-somewhere-else.blurb: Whenever something swings at you, the boots have a strong opinion about being elsewhere, and they act on it before you do.
unique.gilded-iou.name: The Gilded IOU
unique.gilded-iou.blurb: A debt so old and so beautifully lettered that every merchant in Brambleford knocks something off rather than discuss it.
unique.wheelwrights-lucky-spoke.name: Wheelwright's Lucky Spoke
unique.wheelwrights-lucky-spoke.blurb: Prised off the Wheel of Destiny during an argument Lorenzo insists never happened. It still wants to be near gems.
unique.crown-of-the-understudy.name: Crown of the Understudy
unique.crown-of-the-understudy.blurb: Made for whoever was second choice. It grows into you as you grow, having spent its whole life waiting for exactly that.
codex.uniqueBlurb: Eight of them exist. They surface where legendaries do — the Wheel's jackpot and the Well's rarest row — and never twice.
